actions.script: const draft = hireDraft if (!draft.organizationPartyId || !(draft.partyId || (draft.firstName && draft.lastName))) { ec.message.addError('Start with the person') return } hired = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.humanres.PeopleServices.hire#Employee').parameters({ organizationPartyId: draft.organizationPartyId, partyId: draft.partyId, firstName: draft.firstName, lastName: draft.lastName, preferredName: draft.preferredName, workEmail: draft.workEmail, workPhone: draft.workPhone, confirmNewPerson: draft.confirmNewPerson === 'Y', fromDate: draft.fromDate, thruDate: draft.thruDate, departmentPartyId: draft.departmentPartyId, emplPositionId: draft.emplPositionId, managerPartyId: draft.managerPartyId, facilityId: draft.facilityId, reason: String(reason ?? '').trim() || null, requestAccount: requestAccount === 'Y' || requestAccount === true, operationKey: hireOperationKey, employmentOfferId: draft.employmentOfferId || null}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return // the draft is done with if (hireDraftId) ec.service.sync().name('mantle.humanres.PeopleServices.delete#EmploymentDraft').parameters({ employmentDraftId: hireDraftId}).call() hiredPartyId = hired.partyId hiredEmploymentId = hired.partyRelationshipId const person = ec.entity.find('mantle.party.Person').condition('partyId', hired.partyId).disableAuthz().one() ec.message.addMessage([person?.firstName, person?.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(' ') + ' is hired', 'success')

actions.script: const found = preview || {} const person = found.person || {} const terms = found.terms || {} reviewFound = !!found.person reviewTitle = reviewFound ? (person.personName + (person.preferredName ? ' (' + person.preferredName + ')' : '')) : '' reviewRows = [ ['Employer', found.organizationName], ['Person', person.isNew ? 'A new person' : 'Known to People'], ['Employment', found.planText], ['Starts', terms.fromDateText], ['Ends', terms.thruDateText], ['Department', terms.departmentName], ['Position', terms.positionName], ['Manager', terms.managerName], ['Work location', terms.facilityName], ['Work email', hireDraft.workEmail], ['Work phone', hireDraft.workPhone] ].filter(([, value]) => value).map(([label, value]) => ({label, value})) const severityTexts = {error: 'Cannot hire', warning: 'Check', info: 'Note'} findingRows = Array.from(found.findings || []).map(row => Object.assign({}, row, {severityText: severityTexts[row.severity] || ''})) relationshipRows = Array.from(found.relationships || []) canHire = !!found.canHire severityColors = {error: 'negative', warning: 'warning', info: 'grey-8'}
